preconditions_in_order: Explicit user scope decision: permit Travel-workspace information-disclosure tasks; do not call it new flight-buy/cancel coverage.
Parent approves the projection mechanism, immutable train group, public task text and source hashes; retain all original v4 and revision1 decisions.

New event enumeration and decoder retain every send attempt/result/interruption; uniquely bind To/CC/BCC/subject/body/attachments to the same original returned Email. Confirm sent-store insertion scope; generic failures remain unknown, never infer delivery.

CPU boundary checks of original return/effect behavior, strict duplicate-key JSON parsing, six-field row identity/projection and extra output channels; preserve missing/ambiguous as unresolved. Such synthetic contract checks are train-side engineering, not final-test instances.

Fixture review confirms public authoritative file identity, unique requested row, types and all values actually available before send. Freeze task/fixture/tool/runtime/adapter/decoder hashes and complete predeclared plan before any review-case generation.

Record all scripted attempt intents before generation. Freeze causal input/export rules and reference-label schema with source pointers/hashes; AI nonblind annotation plus parent literal/hash/causality validation. Keep training_eligible=false.
bounded_train_coverage_intents: one disallowed outbound channel or destination
one precisely bound original pre-storage rejection, if demonstrably supported
one separately tagged CPU fault/interruption with unknown effect and no private state in visible input
coverage_rules: These are design intents, not labels or promised category counts. No substitution, retry or count expansion to force three classes.
If an intended failure cannot be grounded in the original contract or a clearly isolated fault-test contract, preserve the limitation and stop that attempt without fabricating an executed mutation.
Unknown fault injection is CPU infrastructure testing, not a natural actor sample. Preserve failed/zero-mutation attempts and disclose the distinction.
Keep current five pool targets unchanged. No quorum/retention validation rewriting, no bank/date-update or calendar final-test examples in this batch.
final_test_hold: bank_scheduled_field_preservation and travel_calendar_interval_exclusion remain definition-only final_test intentions. No fixture/test instances/expected labels/CPU run/model inference until a separately approved final-test protocol.
Do not transfer either final-test proposal into train after seeing review, tool limitations or performance. Their public definitions are designer-exposed, not unseen semantics.
completion_and_stop: After at most six attempts, save immutable raw visible exports, causal annotations, failures and hashes; report actual counts without manufacturing balance.
Stop after this finite CPU batch and data-contract review. No automatic next sampling, prompt search, model inference or finetuning.
If scope or any gate fails, generate zero review cases; report the specific blocker and preserve current narrow study scope.
